tagline: Topcon数码单反相机，1969 年发布
description: Topcon于1969年推出的数码单反相机。使用Single long stroke lever (180° with 20° offset).。感光度25 to 1600 ASA (selector dial has a locking lever). There is also a DIN scale on the opposite side of the dial.。

specs.卡口: UV Topcon bayonet mount. The mount included a locking facility when Topcor UV lenses are attached.
specs.取景器: Fresnel screen with central mirco-prism focusing spot, and a fine focusing ring around this. Magnification x 0.75.
specs.感光度: 25 to 1600 ASA (selector dial has a locking lever). There is also a DIN scale on the opposite side of the dial.
specs.闪光灯: Cold shoe and PC terminal. M and X sync (set to X for daylight photography). The X setting would have also been used for class F and S flash bulbs.
specs.胶片/画幅: Single long stroke lever (180° with 20° offset).
specs.尺寸: 141 x 93 x 59mm (W x H x D).
specs.电池: 1 x 1.35v PX625 mercury battery (use the equivalent WeinCELL MRB625 zinc air cell).
specs.英文简介: The Topcon Unirex is a 1969-1973 SLR from Tokyo Kogaku offering TTL spot or averaging metering.
